department: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science

deadline.value: Applications by 12/11/2026 get guaranteed review; later ones are reviewed as space and funding allow until 03/08/2027.
deadline.quote: These are the application deadlines for applicants who wish to begin their graduate studies in fall 2027. | Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science 12/11/2026

funding.value: Graduate School states PhD students have a five-year guaranteed funding period with 12-month stipends.
funding.quote: all Ph.D. students in their five-year guaranteed funding period will receive 12-month stipends.

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's degree (US or equivalent); a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold either a US bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a regionally accredited institution.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE rule stated for this program.
